title: Smoky Shrimp Curry
description: A flavorful and spicy curry dish featuring succulent shrimp and a blend of smoky spices, perfect for a gluten-free meal.
instructions: Heat the coconut oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the onions and cook until they start to brown, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and curry leaves and cook for another minute.
Add the shrimp and cook until they start to turn pink, about 2-3 minutes.
Add the curry powder and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Pour in the chicken broth and coconut milk, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer, then reduce the heat to low and let cook for 5-7 minutes, or until the shrimp are cooked through.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped curry leaves if desired.
